summary: The compliance review of the product 'GoldNow: Digital Top-up on Existing Gold Loans' identified several gaps against the reviewed RBI rules. The most critical issues include non-compliance with the requirement to display contact details of nodal grievance officers, failure to meet the cooling-off period determination by the RE's Board, and insufficient explanation of KFS contents to the borrower.
